comments.story: NandGame – Build a Computer from Scratch
comments.why: Educational DIY VGA video card build
comments.text: If you're a visual learner, check out Ben Eater's channel: [LINK] He has a really great video series where he builds a small computer from scratch on breadboards. Also some other highlights: Reliable data transmission, more educational: [LINK] DIY VGA "video card": [VIDEO] Super educational, but if you want to get into more embedded hardware hacking, I would say that building a homemade computer like he does is probably not a super exciting place to start. I'd recommend picking up some Teensy 4.0 microcontrollers and build some small hardware projects with the microcontroller before diving into lower-level circuitry.
